description_en: Queries the details of an access control policy
description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicy查询管控策略的详情
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager get-control-policy --policy-id cp-SImPt8GCEwiq0000 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the access control policy. Valid values:

*   zh-CN (default value): Chinese
*   en: English
*   ja: Japanese

>  This parameter is valid only for system access control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

- zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
- ja：日文。

> 该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language
